sources.title: tsukumo sana (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[skin tight]] [[halter shirt]], [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]], a [[backless outfit|backless]] [[underbust]] [[blue leotard]] [[leotard under clothes|worn under]] a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[see-through skirt|see-through]] [[white skirt|white]] [[miniskirt]] and a [[blue skirt]] [[overskirt]] with a [[starry sky print]] held with a [[blue bow|blue]] [[back bow|back]] [[skirt bow|bow]] and an [[anklet]]. She also goes [[barefoot]] and [[toenail polish|paints her toenails]] [[blue nails|blue]].
